import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
print("=== Swapping back to old working directory ===")
# Swap back
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("mv /opt/areloria /opt/areloria_broken && mv /opt/areloria_old /opt/areloria")
print("Swapped directories")
# Copy env
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cp /opt/areloria_broken/.env /opt/areloria/.env")
# Fix type module properly using python json
sftp = client.open_sftp()
# Fix root package.json
with sftp.file("/opt/areloria/package.json", "r") as f:
    content = f.read().decode()
import json
try:
    data = json.loads(content)
    if "type" in data:
        del data["type"]
    with sftp.file("/opt/areloria/package.json", "w") as f:
        json.dump(data, f, indent=2)
    print("Fixed root package.json")
except:
    print("Root package.json parse error")
# Fix server package.json
with sftp.file("/opt/areloria/server/package.json", "r") as f:
    content = f.read().decode()
try:
    data = json.loads(content)
    if "type" in data:
        del data["type"]
    with sftp.file("/opt/areloria/server/package.json", "w") as f:
        json.dump(data, f, indent=2)
    print("Fixed server package.json")
except:
    print("Server package.json parse error")
sftp.close()
# Install deps
print("\n=== Installing dependencies ===")
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && pnpm install 2>&1 | tail -10")
print(stdout.read().decode())
# Build
print("\n=== Building ===")
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && pnpm run build 2>&1 | tail -20")
print(stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
